extracted.intended_audience: researchers and practitioners in requirements engineering, NLP, and legal/GDPR compliance (legal experts, requirements engineers, privacy engineers)
extracted.subtask_description: Automated and manual methods for verifying that Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) satisfy GDPR-derived "shall" requirements; includes a set of 45 compliance requirements, glossary, SF-based representations, and scoring guidance for assessing statements in DPAs.

rubrics_metrics.name: R1 (MD1) The DPA shall contain at least one controller’s identity and contact details.
rubrics_metrics.description: The DPA shall contain at least one controller’s identity and contact details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: MD (metadata). Source/annotation: Linklaters LLP. Mandatory requirement (strongly recommended by legal experts). Used to identify the controller for checking other requirements that depend on the controller identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: R2 (MD2) The DPA shall contain at least one processor’s identity and contact details.
rubrics_metrics.description: The DPA shall contain at least one processor’s identity and contact details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: MD (metadata). Source/annotation: Linklaters LLP. Mandatory requirement (strongly recommended by legal experts). Used to identify the processor for checking processor-specific obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: R3 (MD3) The DPA shall contain the duration of the processing.
rubrics_metrics.description: The DPA shall contain the duration of the processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: MD (metadata). Reference: Art. 28(3). Mandatory requirement. DPA must specify processing duration to be GDPR-compliant.

rubrics_metrics.name: R4 (MD4) The DPA shall contain the nature and purpose of the processing.
rubrics_metrics.description: The DPA shall contain the nature and purpose of the processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: MD (metadata). Reference: Art. 28(3). Mandatory requirement. Purpose/nature are required metadata to assess whether processing is within authorized scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: R5 (MD5) The DPA shall contain the types of personal data.
rubrics_metrics.description: The DPA shall contain the types of personal data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: MD (metadata). Reference: Art. 28(3). Mandatory requirement. Specifies what categories/types of personal data are processed.

rubrics_metrics.name: R6 (MD6) The DPA shall contain the categories of data subjects.
rubrics_metrics.description: The DPA shall contain the categories of data subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: MD (metadata). Reference: Art. 28(3). Mandatory requirement. Identifying categories of data subjects is required metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: R7 (PO1) The processor shall not engage a sub-processor without a prior specific or general written authorization of the controller.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall not engage a sub-processor without a prior specific or general written authorization of the controller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(2). Mandatory requirement. When general authorization is used, additional notification/objection rules apply (see R8/CR1). SF-based representation provided in the paper for phrasal-level checking.

rubrics_metrics.name: R8 (PO2) In case of general written authorization, the processor shall inform the controller of any intended changes concerning the addition or replacement of sub-processors.
rubrics_metrics.description: In case of general written authorization, the processor shall inform the controller of any intended changes concerning the addition or replacement of sub-processors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(2). Mandatory requirement when general written authorization is used. Triggers controller's right to object (see CR1).

rubrics_metrics.name: R9 (PO3) The processor shall process personal data only on documented instructions from the controller.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall process personal data only on documented instructions from the controller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(a). Mandatory requirement. Important processor constraint; SF-based representation used to identify actor/object/constraint (processing only on documented instructions).

rubrics_metrics.name: R10 (PO4) If the processor requires by Union or Member State law to process personal data without instructions and law does not prohibit informing the controller on grounds of public interest, the processor shall inform the controller of that legal requirement before processing.
rubrics_metrics.description: If the processor requires by Union or Member State law to process personal data without instructions and law does not prohibit informing the controller on grounds of public interest, the processor shall inform the controller of that legal requirement before processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(a). Mandatory requirement. Conditional obligation: applies when processor is legally required to act without controller's instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: R11 (PO5) The processor shall ensure that persons authorized to process personal data have committed themselves to confidentiality or are under an appropriate statutory obligation of confidentiality.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall ensure that persons authorized to process personal data have committed themselves to confidentiality or are under an appropriate statutory obligation of confidentiality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(b). Mandatory requirement. Covers personnel/confidentiality obligations of individuals with access.

rubrics_metrics.name: R12 (PO6) The processor shall take all measures required pursuant to Article 32 or to ensure the security of processing.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall take all measures required pursuant to Article 32 or to ensure the security of processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(c). Mandatory requirement. Includes implementing appropriate technical and organizational measures; see Art. 32 for examples and risk-based considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: R13 (PO7) The processor shall assist the controller in fulfilling its obligation to respond to requests for exercising the data subject’s rights.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall assist the controller in fulfilling its obligation to respond to requests for exercising the data subject’s rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(e). Mandatory requirement. Processor must provide operational support to enable controller to meet data-subject rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: R14 (PO8) The processor shall assist the controller in ensuring the security of processing.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall assist the controller in ensuring the security of processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(f), Art. 32. Mandatory requirement. Overlaps with R12 but framed as assistance to the controller; SF-based elements capture this relationship.

rubrics_metrics.name: R15 (PO9) The processor shall assist the controller in notifying a personal data breach to the supervisory authority.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall assist the controller in notifying a personal data breach to the supervisory authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(f), Art. 33. Mandatory requirement. Key elements include processor, assist in notifying, controller, personal data breach, supervisory authority; phrasal checking must verify all key elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: R16 (PO10) The processor shall assist the controller in communicating a personal data breach to the data subject.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall assist the controller in communicating a personal data breach to the data subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(f), Art. 34. Mandatory requirement. Distinct from R15 (notification to authority) — must check whether DPA specifies to whom breaches are to be notified.

rubrics_metrics.name: R17 (PO11) The processor shall assist the controller in ensuring compliance with the obligations pursuant to data protection impact assessment (DPIA).
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall assist the controller in ensuring compliance with the obligations pursuant to data protection impact assessment (DPIA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(f), Art. 35. Mandatory requirement. Processor should contribute to DPIA obligations and mitigations.

rubrics_metrics.name: R18 (PO12) The processor shall assist the controller in consulting the supervisory authorities prior to processing where the processing would result in a high risk in the absence of measures taken by the controller to mitigate the risk.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall assist the controller in consulting the supervisory authorities prior to processing where the processing would result in a high risk in the absence of measures taken by the controller to mitigate the risk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(f), Art. 36. Mandatory requirement for high-risk processing scenarios; assistance to controller for consultations.

rubrics_metrics.name: R19 (PO13) The processor shall return or delete all personal data to the controller after the end of the provision of services relating to processing.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall return or delete all personal data to the controller after the end of the provision of services relating to processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(g). Mandatory requirement. Practical implications for software (e.g., archiving before deletion, deletion timing) and for DPA terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: R20 (PO14) The processor shall immediately inform the controller if an instruction infringes the GDPR or other data protection provisions.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall immediately inform the controller if an instruction infringes the GDPR or other data protection provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(h). Mandatory requirement. Processor must proactively flag unlawful controller instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: R21 (PO15) The processor shall make available to the controller information necessary to demonstrate compliance with the obligations Article 28 in GDPR.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall make available to the controller information necessary to demonstrate compliance with the obligations Article 28 in GDPR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(h). Mandatory requirement. Enables controller's oversight and evidence of processor compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: R22 (PO16) The processor shall allow for and contribute to audits, including inspections, conducted by the controller or another auditor mandated by the controller.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall allow for and contribute to audits, including inspections, conducted by the controller or another auditor mandated by the controller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(h). Mandatory requirement. Audit/access obligations should be present in the DPA.

rubrics_metrics.name: R23 (PO17) The processor shall impose the same obligations on the engaged sub-processors by way of contract or other legal act under Union or Member State law.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall impose the same obligations on the engaged sub-processors by way of contract or other legal act under Union or Member State law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(4). Mandatory requirement. Ensures contractual flow-down of obligations to sub-processors; SF representations capture obligation/imposition elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: R24 (PO18) The processor shall remain fully liable to the controller for the performance of sub-processor’s obligations.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall remain fully liable to the controller for the performance of sub-processor’s obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(4). Mandatory requirement. Liability provision: processor remains liable for sub-processor performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: R25 (PO19) When assessing the level of security, the processor shall take into account the risk of accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alternation, unauthorized disclosure of or access to the personal data transmitted, stored or processed.
rubrics_metrics.description: When assessing the level of security, the processor shall take into account the risk of accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alternation, unauthorized disclosure of or access to the personal data transmitted, stored or processed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 32(2). Mandatory requirement. Risk-based security assessment requirements; informs what measures are appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: R26 (CR1) In case of general written authorization, the controller shall have the right to object to changes concerning the addition or replacement of sub-processors, after having been informed of such intended changes by the processor.
rubrics_metrics.description: In case of general written authorization, the controller shall have the right to object to changes concerning the addition or replacement of sub-processors, after having been informed of such intended changes by the processor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: CR (controller's right). Reference: Art. 28(2). Mandatory right tied to R8/PO2. SF representation: controller has the right to object when informed.

rubrics_metrics.name: R27 (MD7) The organizational and technical measures to ensure a level of security can include: (a) pseudonymization and encryption of personal data, (b) ensure confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience of processing systems and services, (c) restore the availability and access to personal data in a timely manner in the event of a physical or technical incident, and (d) regularly testing, assessing and evaluating the effectiveness of technical and organizational measures for ensuring the security of the processing.
rubrics_metrics.description: The organizational and technical measures to ensure a level of security can include: (a) pseudonymization and encryption of personal data, (b) ensure confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience of processing systems and services, (c) restore the availability and access to personal data in a timely manner in the event of a physical or technical incident, and (d) regularly testing, assessing and evaluating the effectiveness of technical and organizational measures for ensuring the security of the processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: MD (metadata). Reference: Art. 32(1). Optional requirement (best-practice). Provides examples of security measures to check for; useful when evaluating R12/R14 and overall technical-organizational measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: R28 (MD8) The notification of personal data breach shall at least include (a) the nature of personal data breach; (b) the name and contact details of the data protection officer; (c) the consequences of the breach; (d) the measures taken or proposed to mitigate its effects.
rubrics_metrics.description: The notification of personal data breach shall at least include (a) the nature of personal data breach; (b) the name and contact details of the data protection officer; (c) the consequences of the breach; (d) the measures taken or proposed to mitigate its effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: MD (metadata). Reference: Art. 33(3). Optional requirement (best-practice). Details content that breach notifications should include; relevant when checking R15/R34.

rubrics_metrics.name: R29 (MD9) The DPIA shall at least include (a) a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of the processing, (b) an assessment of the necessity and proportionality of the processing operations in relation to the purposes, (c) an assessment of the risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects, and (d) the measures envisaged to address the risks.
rubrics_metrics.description: The DPIA shall at least include (a) a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of the processing, (b) an assessment of the necessity and proportionality of the processing operations in relation to the purposes, (c) an assessment of the risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects, and (d) the measures envisaged to address the risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: MD (metadata). Reference: Art. 35(7). Optional requirement (best-practice). Useful for assessing completeness of DPIA-related clauses (R17, R39-42).

rubrics_metrics.name: R30 (PO20) The processor shall not transfer personal data to a third country or international organization without a prior specific or general authorization of the controller.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall not transfer personal data to a third country or international organization without a prior specific or general authorization of the controller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(3)(a). Optional requirement (listed in supplementary material). Check DPA for transfer/authorization clauses and applicable transfer mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: R31 (PO21) The processor can demonstrate guarantees to Article 28 (1–4) through adherence to an approved codes of conduct or an approved certification mechanism.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor can demonstrate guarantees to Article 28 (1–4) through adherence to an approved codes of conduct or an approved certification mechanism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 28(5). Optional requirement. Presence of codes/certifications can be used as evidence of compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: R32 (PO22) The processor shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk of varying likelihood and severity for the rights and freedoms of natural persons.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk of varying likelihood and severity for the rights and freedoms of natural persons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 32(1). Optional requirement (supplementary). Emphasizes risk-based selection of measures (ties to R25).

rubrics_metrics.name: R33 (PO23) The processor shall ensure that any natural person acting under its authority who has access to personal data only process them on instructions from the controller.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall ensure that any natural person acting under its authority who has access to personal data only process them on instructions from the controller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 32(4). Optional requirement. Related to personnel/instruction obligations and confidentiality (R11).

rubrics_metrics.name: R34 (PO24) The processor shall notify the controller without undue delay after becoming aware of a personal data breach.
rubrics_metrics.description: The processor shall notify the controller without undue delay after becoming aware of a personal data breach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 33(2). Optional requirement (supplementary). Important operational timing requirement tied to R15/R28.

rubrics_metrics.name: R35 (PO25) A processor shall be liable for the damage caused by processing only where it has not complied with GDPR obligations specifically directed to processors or where it has acted outside or contrary to lawful instructions of the controller.
rubrics_metrics.description: A processor shall be liable for the damage caused by processing only where it has not complied with GDPR obligations specifically directed to processors or where it has acted outside or contrary to lawful instructions of the controller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: PO (processor's obligation). Reference: Art. 82(2). Optional requirement. Liability allocation principle; relevant for contract drafting and legal risk assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: R36 (CO1) The controller shall inform the supervisory authority no later than 72 hours after having become aware of a personal data breach.
rubrics_metrics.description: The controller shall inform the supervisory authority no later than 72 hours after having become aware of a personal data breach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: CO (controller's obligation). Reference: Art. 33(1). Optional requirement (supplementary). Timing requirement for controller obligations; cross-checks with processor notification duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: R37 (CO2) The controller shall document personal data breaches.
rubrics_metrics.description: The controller shall document personal data breaches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: CO (controller's obligation). Reference: Art. 33(5). Optional requirement (supplementary). Documentation obligation to support reporting and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: R38 (CO3) In case of high risks, the controller shall communicate the data breach to the data subject without undue delay.
rubrics_metrics.description: In case of high risks, the controller shall communicate the data breach to the data subject without undue delay.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: CO (controller's obligation). Reference: Art. 34(1). Optional requirement (supplementary). Distinguishes high-risk notification to data subjects (ties to R16).

rubrics_metrics.name: R39 (CO4) The controller shall carry out a DPIA.
rubrics_metrics.description: The controller shall carry out a DPIA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: CO (controller's obligation). Reference: Art. 35(1). Optional requirement (supplementary). DPIA presence/completeness relates to R29 and processor assistance (R17).

rubrics_metrics.name: R40 (CO5) The controller shall seek advice of the DPO when carrying a DPIA.
rubrics_metrics.description: The controller shall seek advice of the DPO when carrying a DPIA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: CO (controller's obligation). Reference: Art. 35(2). Optional requirement (supplementary). Involvement of DPO is a recommended procedural element in DPIA workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: R41 (CO6) The controller shall seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing.
rubrics_metrics.description: The controller shall seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: CO (controller's obligation). Reference: Art. 35(9). Optional requirement (supplementary). Stakeholder consultation as part of DPIA and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: R42 (CO7) The controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
rubrics_metrics.description: The controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: CO (controller's obligation). Reference: Art. 35(11). Optional requirement (supplementary). Periodic review triggered by changes in risk profile.

rubrics_metrics.name: R43 (CO8) A controller shall be liable for the damage caused by any processing infringing the GDPR.
rubrics_metrics.description: A controller shall be liable for the damage caused by any processing infringing the GDPR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: CO (controller's obligation). Reference: Art. 82(2). Optional requirement (supplementary). Controller liability principle; relevant to contractual allocation of risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: R44 (CR2) The controller shall have the right to suspend the processing in certain cases.
rubrics_metrics.description: The controller shall have the right to suspend the processing in certain cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: CR (controller's right). Source/annotation: Linklaters LLP (supplementary). Optional/right-based clause the DPA can include; provides controller remedies.

rubrics_metrics.name: R45 (CR3) The controller shall have the right to terminate the DPA in certain cases.
rubrics_metrics.description: The controller shall have the right to terminate the DPA in certain cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category: CR (controller's right). Source/annotation: Linklaters LLP (supplementary). Optional/right-based clause; termination rights for controller in specified situations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement categorization and enforcement rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Compliance requirements are grouped into four categories: metadata (MD), processor’s obligation (PO), controller’s right (CR), and controller’s obligation (CO). Of the 45 requirements, 26 are mandatory and 19 optional.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mandatory requirements (R1–R26) are treated as binding for the automated checker: a violation of a mandatory requirement yields a non-compliance decision. Optional requirements (R27–R45) are treated as warnings when violated. The grouping guides phrasal SF representations and evaluation scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Matching degree scoring and manual review guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: For requirements found to be satisfied in a DPA, compute and assign a matching-degree score representing the ratio of key elements present in the DPA statement versus the elements expected by the requirement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Matching degree is used to indicate maximum matching between a requirement and any DPA statement satisfying it. Guidance: statements with maximum matching degree ≤ 0.5 should be prioritized for manual review; reviewing those yields empirical accuracy improvement (paper reports an overall accuracy improvement of 6.4 percentage points when the analyst reviews statements with scores ≤ 0.5). Proportion of such statements is ≈6% on average (≈12 statements per DPA). Scores facilitate human validation of automated findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phrasal-level semantic-frame based evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and DPA statements are represented with semantic-frame (SF) based phrasal representations (predicate + semantic role arguments) to enable fine-grained matching of key elements rather than relying on whole-statement semantic similarity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SF representations (action/actor/object/constraint/etc.) for each requirement (paper provides SF templates for all requirements). Evaluate compliance by aligning SFs of DPA statements to SF-based requirement representations; this helps detect partial satisfaction and missing key elements (e.g., S11 partially matches R15/R16 but misses 'supervisory authority' or 'data subject'). The approach avoids false positives/negatives common with plain semantic similarity measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision and reporting rules for automated checker (DERECHA)
rubrics_metrics.description: DERECHA outputs a compliance report summarizing for each requirement whether it is satisfied, violated, partially satisfied (with matching-degree), or missing, and provides recommendations about missing information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automated approach compares SF representations and reports matched requirements along with missing elements; it raises non-compliance for mandatory violations and warnings for optional violations. The report includes matching-degree scores and recommended remedies (e.g., add missing contact details, specify supervisory authority). The paper reports precision, recall, and accuracy figures for DERECHA versus a baseline.
